paragraphs.en: He arrived near asteroids 325-330 and began his exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 他来到第325至330号小行星附近，开始了探索。

paragraphs.en: The first asteroid hosted a king dressed in royal purple and ermine, seated on an elegant throne.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个小行星上坐着一位身着皇家紫袍和貂皮大衣的国王，他端坐于一座精致的王座之上。

paragraphs.en: "Ah! Here is a subject," the king exclaimed upon seeing the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “啊！找到话题了,”国王见到小王子不禁脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: The little prince wondered how the king recognized him despite never having met before.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子疑惑国王是如何认出他的，尽管他们从未见过面。

paragraphs.en: "Approach so I can see you better," said the king, proud of his new kingdom.
paragraphs.zh: “过来让我看得更清楚些。”国王说道，对自己的新王国感到颇为得意。

paragraphs.en: Finding no place to sit due to the king's robe, the tired prince stood and yawned.
paragraphs.zh: 因国王的长袍占了位置，疲惫的王子站立着打了个哈欠。

paragraphs.en: "It is improper to yawn in my presence," the king declared. "You are forbidden to do it."
paragraphs.zh: “在我面前打哈欠是不恰当的，”国王宣布，“你被禁止这样做。”

paragraphs.en: "I cannot help it; I have been traveling," replied the little prince, embarrassed.
paragraphs.zh: “我控制不住自己，最近一直在旅行。”小王子尴尬地回答。

paragraphs.en: "Yawn again as an order," commanded the king.
paragraphs.zh: “再打个哈欠当作命令。”国王下令道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince was too abashed to comply.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子羞涩得无法答应。

paragraphs.en: "Hum! Hum!" said the king, vexed.
paragraphs.zh: “哼！哼！”国王不满地说道。

paragraphs.en: "Sometimes you must yawn and sometimes--"
paragraphs.zh: “有时候你不得不打个哈欠，有时候——”

paragraphs.en: He faltered, realizing his authority's importance.
paragraphs.zh: 他犹豫了一下，意识到自己权威的重要性。

paragraphs.en: "If I ordered a general to change into a sea bird and he disobeyed, it would be my fault," explained the king.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我命令一名将军变成海鸟而他不服从，那就是我的错。”国王解释道。

paragraphs.en: "May I sit down?" asked the little prince timidly.
paragraphs.zh: “我可以坐下来吗？”小王子怯生生地问道。

paragraphs.en: The king commanded him to do so, gathering in his ermine robe.
paragraphs.zh: 国王命令他这样做，身披貂皮大衣。

paragraphs.en: The prince then questioned the king about his true domain on such a small asteroid.
paragraphs.zh: 王子随后询问国王，在这么一个小行星上，他的真正领地在哪里。

paragraphs.en: The king commanded, "Ask me a question."
paragraphs.zh: 国王下令：“提个问题吧。”

paragraphs.en: "Over what do you rule?" the prince inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “你统治的是什么？”王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "Everything," the king replied with grand simplicity.
paragraphs.zh: “一切,”国王以庄重的简洁回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Everything?"
paragraphs.zh: “一切？”

paragraphs.en: With a gesture, the king encompassed his planet and beyond.
paragraphs.zh: 国王一挥手，仿佛将整个星球乃至更远处都囊括其中。

paragraphs.en: "Do the stars obey you?" the prince asked.
paragraphs.zh: “星辰会听你的话吗？”王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "Certainly they do," said the king. "They obey instantly; insubordination is not tolerated."
paragraphs.zh: “当然会服从，”国王说道，“他们立刻听从命令；任何不服从的行为都是不被容忍的。”

paragraphs.en: The prince was amazed by this power. He wished to see a sunset without moving his chair. With courage, he requested, "Order the sun to set for me."
paragraphs.zh: 王子对这种能力感到惊叹。他希望能坐在原地观赏日落。鼓起勇气，他请求道：“命令太阳为我落下。”

paragraphs.en: "If I ordered a general to transform into a sea bird, would you blame him or me?" the king asked.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我命令一名将军变成海鸟，你会责怪他还是我？”国王问道。

paragraphs.en: "You," said the little prince firmly.
paragraphs.zh: “你,”小王子坚定地说。

paragraphs.en: "Exactly," the king continued. "One must demand what each can perform reasonably. My authority is based on reason; unreasonable orders would lead to rebellion."
paragraphs.zh: “正是如此，”国王继续说道，“每个人都应该被要求完成合理之事。我的权威建立在理性之上；不合理的要求只会引发叛乱。”

paragraphs.en: The prince reminded, "Then my sunset?"
paragraphs.zh: 王子提醒道：“那么我的日落呢？”

paragraphs.en: "You shall have it. I will command it when conditions are right," the king replied, consulting his almanac.
paragraphs.zh: “等条件成熟了，我就会下令实行。”国王查阅着占星历书回答道。

paragraphs.en: "When will that be?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “那会是什么时候？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "Tonight at about twenty minutes to eight," said the king with a smile. "You'll see how well I am obeyed."
paragraphs.zh: “今晚大约七点四十分左右，”国王微笑着说道，“你就会看到我命令执行得多么到位。”

paragraphs.en: The prince yawned, feeling bored and regretting lost time. He told the king, "I have nothing more to do here."
paragraphs.zh: 王子打了个哈欠，显得有些无聊和后悔浪费了时间，他对国王说：“这里我已经没有什么事情可做了。”

paragraphs.en: The king pleaded, "Do not go. I will make you Minister of Justice!"
paragraphs.zh: 国王哀求道：“别走了，我让你做司法大臣！”

paragraphs.en: "Of justice?" replied the little prince skeptically.
paragraphs.zh: “公正？”小王子怀疑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "You will judge yourself," the king insisted. "It is harder than judging others."
paragraphs.zh: “你将自行裁决，”国王坚持道，“这比评判他人要艰难得多。”

paragraphs.en: "But there's no one to judge here!" protested the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “可是这里没有人来评判！”小王子抗议道。

paragraphs.en: "I haven't toured my entire kingdom yet," said the king, tired from walking. "I need a carriage, but it’s too old for me."
paragraphs.zh: “我还没有巡完我的整个王国呢，”国王边说边显得有些疲惫，“我需要一辆马车，但太旧了，不适合我。”

paragraphs.en: The little prince turned around and saw emptiness on both sides of his planet.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子转过身来，发现他的星球两侧一片空旷。

paragraphs.en: "Then you'll judge yourself," the king declared. "You can condemn an old rat to death, but pardon him each time because he's essential."
paragraphs.zh: “那你可就要自己来评判了，”国王宣布道，“你可以将一只老耗子判死刑，但每次又因它不可或缺而予以赦免。”

paragraphs.en: "I don't like condemning anyone," said the little prince. "I think I’ll go."
paragraphs.zh: “我不喜欢谴责任何人，”小王子说道，“我想我还是走吧。”

paragraphs.en: "No," countered the king.
paragraphs.zh: “不,”国王坚定地反驳道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince, ready for departure, decided not to upset the monarch.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子准备启程，决定不惹恼这位君王。

paragraphs.en: "If Your Majesty wants obedience," he said, "give a clear order—leave within one minute." He then left with a sigh.
paragraphs.zh: “如果陛下想要服从，”他说，“那就下一道明确的命令——一分钟内离开。”说完，他叹了口气离开了。

paragraphs.en: "Remember, you were my Ambassador!" called out the king hastily.
paragraphs.zh: “你还记得你曾经是我的大使！”国王急忙喊道。

paragraphs.en: As the little prince walked on, he mused, "Grown-ups are strange."
paragraphs.zh: 小王子继续走着，不禁思索道：“大人们真是奇怪。”
